# Test current behavior to understand what passes/fails now
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver.version import Version

# Test Arabic-Indic digits
print("Testing Arabic-Indic digits:")
try:
    result = Version.parse('1\u0662.2.3')
    print(f"  parse('1{chr(0x0662)}.2.3') -> {result}")
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"  parse('1{chr(0x0662)}.2.3') -> ValueError: {e}")

print(f"  is_valid('1{chr(0x0662)}.2.3') -> {Version.is_valid('1\u0662.2.3')}")

# Test trailing newline
print("\nTesting trailing newline:")
try:
    result = Version.parse('1.2.3\n')
    print(f"  parse('1.2.3\\n') -> {result}")
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"  parse('1.2.3\\n') -> ValueError: {e}")

print(f"  is_valid('1.2.3\\n') -> {Version.is_valid('1.2.3\n')}")

# Test bump_build
print("\nTesting bump_build:")
v1 = Version.parse('1.2.3+alpha')
bumped1 = v1.bump_build()
print(f"  parse('1.2.3+alpha').bump_build().build = {repr(bumped1.build)}")

v2 = Version.parse('1.2.3+build.9')
bumped2 = v2.bump_build()
print(f"  parse('1.2.3+build.9').bump_build().build = {repr(bumped2.build)}")
